main_text.p: Stertere] Stertere nafo, Perf. Rhonchiffare, Plaut. Profl are somnum pectore, Virg.
Stertor, propr.] Rhonchus, Mart. Gutturis stridor, Amm.
Stigma] Inscriptio frontis, Sen. Victurum in capite punctum, Veget. Nota publica. Cod.
Stigma alicui imponere] Stigma alicui inscribere, Sen. Inscribere aliquid in fronte, Cic. Ferrô genas altius sulcare, Amm.

Stigmaticus] Stigmatias, æ, Cic. Stigmosus, Plin. Literatus, Plaut. Literatus frontem, Apul. Samii literati, Aristoph. Deformatus stigmatum notis, Suet. Threjiciis compunctus notis, Cic. Subverbustus, Plaut. vel Subvervustus, Tertull. Inustus, Bud. Inscriptus, Lipf. Inscripti vultus.

Stillare] Stillat arbor guttis, vel guttas. Destillant aquæ, Tibull. Instillare oleum lumini, Cic. Stillam demittere. Guttam instillare. Guttatim fundere. Impluere in aliquem locum, Plin. Malum cùm impluit cæteros, non impluat mihi, Plaut. Stillæ decidunt in, Vitr. Cafitant stillicidia, Paul. I. C.
Stillatio] Stillatus, us, Ovid. Stillicidium, Destillatio, Plin. Stiricidium, cum stillæ concretæ cadunt, Fest.
Stillatitius] Stillatus, Ovid. Stillatis guttans, Plin.

Stimulare] Subjectis stimulis lassare, Hor. Fodicare, vel fodere latus alicujus, Id. Stimulis aliquem fodere, Cic. Stimulos adigere mancipio, Sen. Umbone pellere aliquem, Mart. Subditare stimulum, Lucr. Stimulos adhibere, adjicere, admovere, subdere, Ovid. Cic.
Stipendiarius] Tributarius alicujus, Justin. Vectigalis homo, Cic. Stipendiosus miles, veget.
Stipendium] Vectigal, & Stipendiarium vectigal, &c. Pensitatio stipendii, I. C.
Stipendium militare] Stipendium castrense, Plin. Jun. Martiaticum, Priscian. Manupretium castrensium laborum, Sen. Æs militare, Var. Attributum : pecunia militibus assignata

page.notes: Scan is faded; some words such as "Profl are", "Cafitant" and "Tertull." (printed "Taubm.") are uncertain. The printed "Taubm." is transcribed as printed. The printed "Var," is read as "Var.", and "Veget." as "Veget." per the scan's abbreviation.
